name: Better Scrapers
description: Rate-limited Scrape All and one-click Save All controls for Cove's video tagger.
author: jiwenji

versions.changelog:
Fixed saved settings appearing to reset after refreshing and scraping continuing to use default values. The settings endpoint now correctly returns stored settings.

Install the attached ZIP and restart Cove. Previously saved settings should load correctly after updating.
Restore Better Scrapers controls on Cove 1.3's updated video-tagger toolbar and declare explicit Cove authorization policies for extension settings.
Initial registry release with Scrape All, selection-aware Scrape Selected, rolling rate-limited batches, exponential 429 backoff, Save All, and optional automatic saving after each successful scrape.
